items.title: The U.S. is building barriers around drones and robots, but China has scale to get around them
items.feed_excerpt: The U.S. is shutting out more foreign-made drones and robots. China’s scale means the global competition may simply move elsewhere.

items.title: Grindr wants to be the everything app for gay men; investors are still deciding whether it can pull it off
items.feed_excerpt: George Arison is done letting Wall Street's "Grindr discount" go unchallenged — in a wide-ranging Q&A, the CEO walks us through how AI, a controversial $350-plus EDGE tier, and a bet on healthcare and long-distance matchmaking are turning Grindr into the "gayborhood in your pocket" he's been promising since 2022.

items.feed_excerpt: Circleback is also introducing new pricing plans starting from $14 per month

items.title: Instagram puts new limits on undisclosed AI profiles
items.feed_excerpt: As frustration over AI influencers has been growing, Instagram is limiting the reach of undisclosed AI profiles.

items.title: Apple’s top App Store exec, Phil Schiller, follows wave of exits as CEO Tim Cook steps down
items.feed_excerpt: The longtime executive won't be leaving Apple just yet but staff at the company say it's a step closer to Schiller retiring.

items.feed_excerpt: Microsoft says it's testing a fix for the widespread Outlook issues that have led to email delays and failures.

items.feed_excerpt: The disciplinary action comes two months after the Commodity Futures Trading Commission settled charges against Santos.

items.title: Harvard Law dropout raises $6M for Blue Voice to build a ‘Harvey for police officers’
items.feed_excerpt: The seed round for the app that provides real-time legal and policy guidance to officers was led by SignalFire and Las Olas VC.

items.title: Hackers claim millions of patient records stolen during data breach at healthcare giant McKesson
items.feed_excerpt: The company, which distributes medicines and medical devices to hospitals and healthcare practices across the U.S., said it was hacked and expects intermittent service degradation.

items.title: Ryan Breslow is raising up to $27M in pay-to-play bridge funding to save Bolt
items.feed_excerpt: The controversial founder of the checkout startup once valued at $11 billion is putting in $5 million of his own money.

items.title: Tim Cook’s parting message: Apple is in the hands of a product builder
items.feed_excerpt: Tim Cook’s farewell memo to Apple employees offers a glimpse at how he wants John Ternus to be seen: as a product builder with deep experience across the iPhone, Mac, AirPods, and other major hardware lines.

items.title: VLC crosses 7 billion downloads
items.feed_excerpt: In our world of expensive streaming platforms, the very free and offline VLC media player has crossed 7 billion downloads.

items.title: Clipto uses AI to search terabytes of video and is now valued at $250M
items.feed_excerpt: The three-year-old startup says it reached $15 million in ARR and profitability before raising its latest $15 million round.

items.title: How AI could make it harder for governments to use hacking tools
items.feed_excerpt: AI is proving effective at finding and exploiting vulnerabilities. Some say this will make it harder for governments to use hacking tools and spyware and could reignite calls to backdoor devices.

items.title: Nvidia’s $3.5B MediaTek bet reveals its plan for tackling Big Tech’s AI chip buildout
items.feed_excerpt: Nvidia invests $3.5 billion into Taiwanese chipmaker MediaTek. The deal shows how Nvidia plans to stay essential to AI infrastructure as Big Tech begins to build its own AI chips.

items.title: MapQuest’s app surges to No. 1 in Navigation after refusing to rename Lake Ontario
items.feed_excerpt: MapQuest is getting an unexpected boost from its decision to defy President Trump’s renaming of Lake Ontario.
